en: That tender feeling began to grow in the heart of the great saint, like the moon gradually increasing in the light fortnight.

sa: राजोवाच भूयसा परिहारेण सत्कारेण च भूयसा। पूजितो ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ भूयो वस गृहे मम॥
en: The king said Reside in my abode, O Brahmana. I shall always treat you with respect and honour, and always adore you.

sa: त्वां तु नि:संशयं सीता दृष्ट्वा तु मृगरूपिणम्। गृह्यतामिति भर्तारं लक्ष्मणं चाभिधास्यति ॥
en: Seeing you helpless, in the shape of a deer, Sītā will say to her lord and Lakşmaņa also, Do you catch it.

sa: त्वं तु बालस्वभावश्च बुद्धिहीनश्च राक्षस । ज्ञातव्यं तन्न जानीषे कथं राजा भविष्यसि॥
en: And. O Raksasa, you are childish and foolish; and dose not know what you should. How can you then become the king?

sa: यो हि दत्त्वा द्विपश्रेष्ठं कक्ष्यायां कुरुते मनः। रज्जुस्नेहेन किं तस्य त्यजतः कुञ्जरोत्तमम्॥
en: Of what avail is a person's attachment for the tether of a goodly elephant, when the elephant itself is renounced by him?

sa: इतीव तद्वाक्यमदुष्टभावा सुदुष्टमुक्त्वा रजनीचरं तम्। गात्रप्रकम्पाद् व्यथिता बभूव वातोद्धता सा कदलीव तन्वी॥
en: Addressing those words to that wicked ranger of the night, that innocent ($ītā) shook like a plantain tree shaken by the wind.

sa: इदं च वैष्णवं राम धनुः परपुरजयम्॥ ऋचीके भार्गवे प्रादाद् विष्णुः स न्यासमुत्तमम्।
en: O Rāma, this bow belonging to Vişnu, capable of conquering hostile cities, Vişnu consigned to Bhrgus' son, Reika, as a worthy trust.

sa: स तु मामब्रवीदिन्द्रो यदा रामः सलक्ष्मणः॥ छेत्स्यते समरे बाहू तदा स्वर्गं गमिष्यति।
en: Indra said to me, 'You shall attain to heaven when Rāma, along with Laksmana, shall cut off your arms in a battle.'

sa: वेपमाना कृशा दीना सह देव्या सुमित्रया॥ कौसल्या तत्र जग्राह कराभ्यां चरणौ मुनेः।
en: Lean and trembling and in woeful guise, Kausalyā along with the noble Sumitrā, with her hands took the feet of the ascetic.

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान् प्रतिव्यूह्य युद्धे राजा प्रवासितः। स च शैलवरे रम्ये बभूवाभिरतो मुनिः॥
en: Having engaged with them in battle, the king was excited (by them). And on the romantic Himavat, he become engaged in asceticism.

sa: स तं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चैव निरामयम्। पितॄन् स परिपप्रच्छ वाजिहर्तारमेव च॥
en: Having gone round him, and asked him as to his welfare, he enquired after his uncles and the stealer of the horse.

sa: हते तु वीरे प्लवगाधिपे तदा वनेचरास्तत्र न शर्म लेभिरे। वनेचराः सिंहयुते महावने यथा हि गावो निहते गवां पतौ॥
en: Like to kine, incapable of enjoying peace in a mighty forest filled with lions, their chief being dead, these forest-rangers could not attain to felicity on the demise of that lord of monkeys.

sa: ततः क्रोधो ममापूर्वो धैर्यस्योपरि वर्धते। वैरं च सुमहज्जातं रामं प्रति सुदारुणम् ॥
en: Hence unprecedented is my wrath, towering above my patience; and great and fierce also is the hostility I have conceived against Rāma.

sa: बालिशो बत कामात्मा राजा दशरथो भृशम्। स्त्रीकृते यः प्रियं पुत्रं वनं प्रस्थापयिष्यति॥
en: Alas! king Dasaratha is foolish and lustful; for he sends his beloved son to the forest for the sake of his wife.

sa: अपीदानीं स कालः स्याद् वनात् प्रत्यागतं पुनः। यत् त्वां पुत्रक पश्येयं जटाबल्कलधारिणम्॥
en: Oh my darling, shall that day ever come, when I shall see you return from the forest, wearing bark and matted hair.

sa: स राजा रजनी षष्ठी रामे प्रवाजिते वनम्। अर्धरात्रे दशरथः सोऽस्मरद् दुष्कृतं कृतम्॥
en: And on the sixth night after Rāma had repaired to the forest, the king Dasaratha, when it midnight, remembered his unrighteous act.

sa: अहमस्मिन् गिरौ दुर्गे बहुयोजनमायते। चिरान्निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीणप्राणपराक्रमः॥ तं मामेवङ्गतं पुत्रः सुपार्यो नाम नामतः। आहारेण यथाकालं विभर्ति पततां वरः॥
en: For a long time I lay here, old, and of feeble life and energy. that best of birds, my son named Supārswa, coming to me, at the proper hour maintained me with food.

sa: अपि मे गुरुणा रामः पूजितः कुशिकात्मज । इहागतो महातेजाः पूजां प्राप्य महात्मनः॥
en: And, O son of Kusika, has the highly energetic Rāma come hither, after having been rendered homage by my high-souled revered sire?

sa: तत्र प्राग्ज्योतिषं नाम जातरूपमयं पुरम्। यस्मिन् वसति दुष्टात्मा नरको नाम दानवः ॥
en: In it is a city named Prāgjyotişa, all of gold. There dwells the wicked Dänava named Naraka.* *i.e. in the Varadha hill.

sa: यदि दत्त्वा वरौ राजन् पुनः प्रत्यनुतप्यसे। धार्मिकत्वं कथं वीर पृथिव्यां कथयिष्यसि ॥
en: If, O monarch, having conferred the boon, you repent afterwards, how, O hero, will you speak of your righteousness in the world?

sa: नयश्च विनयश्चोभौ यस्मिन् सत्यं च सुस्थितम्। विक्रमश्च यथा दृष्टः स राजा देशकालवित्॥
en: That king is said to be cognizant of time and place; in him dwelleth modesty, truthfulness, prowess and a love for discipline.

sa: वनवासे क्षयं प्राप्ते ममैष हि मनोरथः। यदनेन रथेनैव त्वां वहेयं पुरी पुनः॥
en: This is my desire that the term of exile over, I may carry you back to the palace on this very car.

sa: अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्यां रामः सम्प्रस्थितो वनम्। कृतस्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः॥ विराजयन् राजसुतो राजमार्ग नरैर्वृतम्। हृदयान्याममन्थेव जनस्य गुणवत्तया॥
en: Rāma, intent on repairing to the forest, and treading in pious tracks, after duly saluting Kausalyā and beautifying the royal road, crowded with people, captivated their hearts by means of his high accomplishments.

sa: न पश्यामि भयस्थानं भयं चैवोपधारये। भ्रष्टश्च स्वरयोगो मे छाया चापगता मम। जुगुप्सु इव चात्मानं न च पश्यामि कारणम्॥
en: Ground of fear find I none, yet am I subject to fear. My voice is untuned, and my grace fled, and I begin to despise my life, nor know I the reason why.

sa: देवकार्याणि कुर्वद्भिर्यानीमानि कृतानि वै। पुष्पैः कुवलयैः सार्धं म्लानत्वं न तु यान्ति वै॥
en: These flowers, of blue colour which they offered to the deities, being engaged in divine services, have not yet been withered away.

sa: पश्यन् वनानि चित्राणि पर्वतांश्चाभ्रसंनिभान्। सरांसि सरितश्चैव पथि मार्गवशानुगान्॥ . सुतीक्ष्णेनोपदिष्टेन गत्वा तेन पथा सुखम्। इदं परमसंहष्टो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: And, pleasantly proceeding by the way dire ted by Sutiksna, seeing picturesque woods, hills resembling clouds, watery expanses and streams flowing by their path; Rāma filled with delight said these words to Lakşmana,

sa: मातरं मां च सम्पश्यन् वसेमामद्य शर्वरीम्। तर्पितः सर्वकामैस्त्वं श्वः काल्ये साधयिष्यसि ॥
en: Do you, seeing me as well as your mother, stay here to-night, Then ministered to every way, you will set out to-morrow.

sa: एवं लक्ष्मणमुक्त्वा तु राघवो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः। तस्मिन् देशे बहुफले न्यवसत् स सुखं सुखी॥
en: Having said this to Lakşmana, Rāghava— the enhancer of auspiciousness experiencing felicity, began to dwell happily in that region filled with fruits.

sa: नत्वा पादावहं तस्य मुकुटेनास्पृशं प्रभो। अपि वाली मम क्रोधान्न प्रसादं चकार सः॥
en: And, O lord, I, bowing, touched his feet with my crown; yet from anger Vāli did not extend to me his grace.

sa: न हि रथ्याः सुशक्यन्ते गन्तुं बहुजनाकुलाः। आरुह्य तस्मात् प्रासादाद् दीनाः पश्यन्ति राघवम्॥
en: Unable to thread the streets because of a vast concourse, they ascending the terraces of the buildings, eyed Rāghava with woebegone eyes.

sa: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च पृथिवीं चापि लक्ष्मण। इच्छामि भवतामर्थे एतत् प्रतिश्रृणोमि ते॥
en: I swear to you, I wish for the (possession of) righteousness, interest, desire and the earth, in your interests alone, O Laksmana.

sa: आयस्ते विपुलः कच्चित् कच्चिदल्पतरो व्ययः। अपात्रेषु न ते कच्चित् कोषो गच्छति राघव॥
en: And are your incomings great and outgoings slender? And, O Raghu's descendant, you do not give away your coffers to the undeserving?

sa: कूजितं नू पुराणां च काञ्चीनां निःस्वनं तता स निशम्य ततः श्रीमान् सौमित्रिर्लज्रितोऽभवत्॥
en: Hearing the sounds of women's girdles and their Nupurs*, the graceful Lakşınaņa became highly ashamed. *An ornament for their toes or feet.

sa: अनुरक्ता हि मनुजा राजानं बहुभिर्गुणैः। त्वां च मां च नरव्याघ्र शत्रुघ्नभरतौ तथा॥
en: O foremost of men, the people are attached to yourself, the monarch, Bharata, Satrughna, and myself, because of our various good qualities.

sa: कामवृत्तमनार्यं वा मृषावादिनमेव च॥ धिक् त्वामिति परे लोके व्यक्तं वक्ष्यति मे पिता।
en: O shame on you!' For certain shall my father address me with these words relating to my passionate, false and base conduct.

sa: कथं नु पुत्राः पितरं हन्युः कस्यांचिदापदि। भ्राता वा भ्रातरं हन्यात् सौमित्रे प्राणमात्मनः॥
en: Do sons, in times of peril, ever slay their father, or brothers their brother like to their life, O son of Sumitrā?

sa: न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित् पथि परिश्रमः। पृष्ठतस्तव गच्छन्त्या विहारशयनेष्विव ॥
en: No toil shall I suffer on the way, as if lying on a bed of luxury, while following you in they footstep.

sa: स च तां रामदयितां पश्यन् मायामयो मृगः॥ विचचार ततस्तत्र दीपयन्निव तद् वनम्।
en: That illusive deer seeing Rāma's wife began to inove around as if lighting up that forest (with the fire of its beauty).

sa: चतुर्दशे हि सम्पूर्णे वर्षेऽहनि रघूत्तम॥ न द्रक्ष्यामि यदि त्वां तु प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्।
en: O foremost of Raghus, if after the completion of the fourteen year, I do not see you, I shall enter into fire.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं पृष्ट्वा तु राजानं
en: Vaishampayana said : Having asked the king, she asked the children.

sa: मा शोकं मा च संतापं धैर्यमाश्रय पुत्रक। त्वदधीना हि नगरी राज्यं चैतदनामयम्॥
en: Do not give way to sorrow. O son, assume patience. This city is subject to you, as well as this peaceful kingdom.

sa: पशूनां त्रिशतं तत्र यूपेषु नियतं तदा। अश्वरत्नोत्तमं तत्र राज्ञो दशरथस्य ह ॥
en: And to these Yūpas were bound, three hundred beasts, as well as the foremost of the best horses belonging to king Dasaratha.

sa: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन् सततं प्रियवादिनः। अप्रियस्य च पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः॥
en: O king, the speaker of soft words is common, but the speaker and the listener of unwelcome though beneficial words are rarities.

sa: उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा कौन्तेय किमिदं कृतम्। साहसं बत भद्रं ते देवानामथ चाप्रियम्॥
en: Be blessed; if you wish to do good to me, you should never again commit such rash acts, nor offend the celestials."

sa: एष तस्याश्रमः पुण्यो य एषोऽग्रे विराजते। क्षान्त उष्यात्र षड्रात्रं प्राप्नोति सुगतिं नरः॥
en: This is his sacred hermitage, situated before us. The man who passes six nights here with controlled passions obtains the blessed state.

sa: पर्व चैव चतुर्विशं तदा सूर्यमुपस्थितम्। तथा धर्मगतं रौद्रं सोमं सूर्यगतं च तम्॥
en: He also saw the twenty four Parvas adoring the sun. The beautiful Soma was also present in the sun with such surroundings.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समाप्ते राजसूये तु क्रतुश्रेष्ठे सुदुर्लभे। शिष्यैः परिवृतो व्यासः पुरस्तात् समपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said When that best of sacrifices, Rajasuya, ever difficult of accomplishment, completed, Vyasa, surrounded by his disciples, came before him (Yudhishthira).

sa: आक्रोशतां हि भूतानां यः करोति हि निष्कृतिम्। अग्निः स निष्कृति म शोभयत्यभिसेविते॥
en: That fire has another name called Nishkriti, because he accomplishes the Nishkriti of all creatures, when properly worshipped, he gives good fortune.

sa: एताश्चान्याश्च वै बह्वीः कथयित्वा कथाः शुभाः। बकेन सह देवेन्द्र आपृच्छय त्रिदिवं गतः॥
en: Markandeya said : Having talked over this and various other auspicious things with Baka, the chief of the celestial went to heaven.

sa: अद्य चन्द्राभवक्त्रं तं न पश्यामि नलं यदि। असंख्येगुणं वीरं विनश्यामि न संशयः॥
en: If I do not see Nala, that hero of innumerable virtues and whose face is like the moon, surely I will die.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच ततः प्रशाम्य नगरं दानवांश्च निहत्य तान्। पुनर्मातलिना सार्धमगच्छं देवसद्म तत्॥
en: Arjuna said : Having killed the Danavas and subdued (their) city, I returned to the abode of the celestials accompanied by Matali.

sa: भ्राता बालश्च राजा च न च संग्राममूर्धनि। प्रमत्तश्च हतो वीरस्तं हनिष्ये जनार्दनम्॥
en: My royal brother was a boy and that hero was killed in the battle field unprepared and therefore I shall kill Janarddana."

sa: अपि चात्र महाराज स्वयं विश्वांवसुर्जगौ। इमं श्लोकं तदा वीर प्रेक्ष्य दीक्षां महात्मनः॥
en: O great king, O hero, here also Vibhavasu (fire) himself, going there and seeing that highsouled Rishis' initiation, recited the following sloka.

sa: युध्येयं येन भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च कृपेण च। सूतपुत्रेण च रणे नित्यं कटुकभाषिणा॥
en: The weapon by the help of which I may fight with Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and the ever abusive son of Suta (Karna).

sa: पश्यन्ति हि भवन्तोऽद्य मय्यतीव व्यतिक्रमम्। कृतानि तु परोक्षं मे यानि तानि निबोधत॥
en: Look, Sirs, at the hostility that he bears towards me. Known also all that he has done against me at my back.

sa: एवमेतत् त्वया कार्यमापृष्टोऽसि व्रजाम्यहम्। ता न शक्या महत्यो वै आपस्ततु मया विना॥
en: I now depart, you should act according to my instructions, for without my help, you cannot save yourself from the fearful flood.”

sa: तौ मुक्तौ सायको ताभ्यां समं तत्र निपेततुः। मूकस्य गात्रे विस्तीर्णे शैलसंहनने तदा॥
en: The two arrows thus shot by the two (men) fell at the same time on the huge and adamantine body of Muka.

sa: अब्रवीच्च पुनर्भीमं रोषात् प्रस्फुरिताधरः। न मे मूढा दिशः पाप त्वदर्थं मे विलम्बितम्॥
en: With his lips trembling in anger, he thus spoke to Bhima,“ sinful wretch, I am not bewildered; I am waiting for you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्यामो युवा लोहिताक्षः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः। नकुलो ग्लह एवैको विद्ध्येतन्मम तद्धनम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said This youthful, fair-coloured Nakula with mighty arms, with lion-like necks, and with red eyes is now one of my stakes.

sa: असत्यो विक्रमो नृणामिति मेधीयते मतिः। यथेदं मे त्वया नाग बलं प्रतिहतं महत्॥
en: Now it appears to my mind that the strength of men is fruitless, since, O serpent, you have overmastered my great strength."

sa: ततः शतघ्नीश्च महागदाश्च दीप्तांश्च शूलान् मुसलानसींश्च। चिक्षेप रोपान्मयि मन्दबुद्धिः शाल्वो महाराज जयाभिकाक्षी॥
en: O great king, thereupon eagerly desiring victory, that wicked-minded (Danava) hurled at me Shataghnis, great maces, flaming lances, big clubs and swords.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच वाक्यं न मे रोचते यत् त्वयोक्तं यत् ते प्रियं तत् क्रियतां नरेन्द्र। पश्चात् तप्स्यसे तदुपाक्रम्य वाक्यं न हीदृशं भावि वचो हि धर्म्यम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The words uttered by you do not recommend themselves to me. (However) O ruler of men, do what is agreeable to you. You shall have to repent for acting according to these words, for words fraught with such impiety cannot bring.in prosperity.

sa: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य वयं सर्वे महात्मनः। मन्यामहे जितानाजौ परान् प्राप्तां च मेदिनीम्॥
en: Relying on the prowess of the arms of which illustrious here, we all consider our enemies vanquished and the earth (already) acquired.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच भवानेव महर्षीणां वृद्धानां पर्युपासिता। अज्ञातं मानुषे लोके भवतो नास्ति किंचन॥
en: Arjuna said: You have respectfully worshipped the old and great Rishis; there is nothing on this earth which is unknown to you.

sa: ततो वृष्णिप्रवीरांस्तान् बालान् हत्वा बहूस्तदा। पुरोद्यानानि सर्वाणि भेदयामास दुर्मतिः॥ पुनस्तत्र तत्र प्रधावति।
en: Thereupon slaying a numberless young princes of the Vrishni race, the wicked-minded one laid waste all the gardens belonging to the city.

sa: न शोचाम्यहमात्मानं न चान्यदपि किंचन। कथं नु भवितास्येक इति त्वां नृप शोचिमि॥
en: I lament not for myself, nor for any thing else. But, O king, I only grieve thinking, how you will live alone.

sa: कर्ण उवाच काममीक्षामहे सर्वे दुर्योधन तवेप्सितम्। ऐकमत्यं हि नो राजन् सर्वेषामेव लक्षये।॥
en: Karna said: O Duryodhana, all of us scek to accomplish your wish. O king, I observe unanimity of opinion amongst us all.

sa: ततोऽभवत् तम इव प्रकाश इव चाभवत्। दुर्दिनं सुदिनं चैव शीतमुष्णं च भारत॥ अङ्गारपांशुवर्षे च शस्त्रवर्षं च भारत। एवं मायां प्रकुर्वाणो योधयामास मां रिपुः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, then there was darkness and light alternately, the day was now fair, now gloomy and now hot and now cold. There was a fearful shower of cools, ashes and weapons. Creating such illusions, the enemy fought with me.

sa: नैनं प्रज्ञा सुनीतं वा त्रायते नैव पौरुषम्। योऽयमिच्छेद् यथा कामं तं तं कामं स आप्नुयात्।८॥ यदि स्यादपराधीनं पौरुषस्य क्रियाफलम्। संयताश्चापि दक्षाश्च मतिमन्तश्च मानवाः॥
en: Neither learning nor good morals, nor personal exertion can save them. If the fruits of one's exertions were not dependent on any thing else, men would have obtained the object of their desire by their own exertions. Able, intelligent and diligent men.

sa: वयं तु न भयादस्य कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः। प्रयच्छामः करान्सर्वे न लोभान्न च सान्त्वनात्॥
en: We have not paid tribute to the illustrious son of Kunti out of fear of temptation (the desire of gain) or conciliation:

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ततश्चेदिपतिनृपः। भीष्मं रुक्षाक्षरा वाचः श्रावयामास भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having heard his words, the king of the Chedis spoke thus to Bhishma in stem and harsh words.

sa: इदं कर्म न शक्तस्त्वं वोढुमेकः कथंचन। मया तु हिंसितस्तातो मन्यमानेन तं मृगम्॥
en: Paravasu said: You will never be able to perform this act alone. I have killed our father, mistaking him for a deer.

sa: योः स्नातः साधयेत् तत्र गिरौ कालञ्जरे नृप। स्वर्गलोके महीयेत नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: O king, he who after a bath offers there oblations to the Pitris and the celestials is without doubt adored in heaven.

sa: देवानां च ऋषीणां च गन्धर्वाणां च सर्वशः। पिशाचानां सयक्षाणां तथैव च सुरद्विषाम्॥
en: Of the celestials, of the Rishis, of all the Gandharva, of the Pishachas, of the Yakshas, of the enemies of the gods,

sa: तच्च राजन्नपश्यन्त्याः का शान्तिर्हदयस्य मे। यत् ते भ्रातृन् महाराज युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः॥ अभोजयन्त मिष्टान्नैः सूदाः परमसंस्कृतैः। सर्वांस्तानद्य पश्यामि वने वन्येन जीविनः॥ अदुःखार्हान् मनुष्येन्द्र नोपशाम्यति मे मनः। भीमसेनमिमं चापि दुःखितं वनवासिनम्॥ ध्यायत: किं न मन्युस्ते प्राप्ते काले विवर्धते। भीमसेनं हि कर्माणि स्वयं कुर्वाणमन्युतम्॥ सुखा/ दुःखितं दृष्ट्वा कस्मान्मन्युर्न वर्धते।
en: Not beholding all these, how can my heart, O king have peace! Thy youthful brothers, adorned with ear-rings, were formerly treated by cooks with sweat and skillfully prepared dishes-I now behold them all, unused to misery, in the forest living on the produces of the forest. My mind finds no peace, O lord of men. Beholding this Bhimasena sorry and living in forest and thinking over this, does not your mind in proper time become wrathful, Bhimasena who used to perforin all actions unaided.

sa: पश्यन्तु विप्राः परिपूर्णविद्याः सहैव राज्ञा सपुरोधमुख्याः। उताहो वाप्युच्चतां नीचता वा तूष्णीभूतेष्वेव सर्वेष्वथाद्य॥
en: When others will be silenced, then the learned men and the king with his chief priests will judge my superiority or inferiority.

sa: मयूरैश्चमरैश्चैव वानरै रुरुभिस्तथा। वराहैर्गवयैश्चैव महिषैश्च समावृतान्॥
en: Full of peacocks, Chamaru cows, apes, Rurus, bears, Gavayas and buffaloes,

sa: रुद्रावर्तं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to the Rudravarta. O king, bathing there one goes to the celestials region.

sa: कद कृत्य तु स तान् राक्षसान् भीमविक्रमः। व्यगाहत महातेजास्ते तं सर्वे न्यवारयन्॥
en: Not heeding them at all, that greatly powerful one plunged (into the lake). But they (the Rakshasas) prepared themselves to oppose him.

sa: पौरा ऊचुः नेदमस्ति कुलं सर्वं न वयं न च नो गृहाः॥ यत्र दुर्योधनः पापः सौबलेनाभिपालितः। कर्णदुःशासनाभ्यां च राज्यमेतच्चिकीर्षति॥
en: The citizens said : When the sinful Duryodhana, helped by the son of Subala (Shakuni), (Shakuni), Karna and Dushasana, aspires to this kingdom, our families, our homes, nay we ourselves are all gone.

sa: स्वयं च स्नापयाम्येतौ तथा पादौ प्रधावये। आहारं च प्रयच्छामि स्वयं च द्विजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, with my own hands I assist them in bathing; I also wash their feet, I give them food.

sa: तद् यदा मन्यसे ब्रह्मन् गमनं तीर्थदर्शने। तदैव गन्तास्मि तीर्थान्येष मे निश्चयः परः॥
en: O Brahmana, I shall start to visit the Tirthas at whatever hour you are pleased to appoint. This is my firm resolve.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स पाण्डवो विप्रं मार्कण्डेयमुवाच ह। कथयस्वेति चरितं मनोवैवस्वतस्य च॥शा
en: Vaishampayana said: Then that son of Pandu (Yudhishthira) spoke thus to the Brahmana Markandeya, “narrate (to me) the history of Vaivasvata Manu.”

sa: एवं लब्ध्वा वरान् बाला दर्पपूर्णास्तपस्विनः। क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यन्ति यथा न स्यात् तथा भवान्॥
en: Thus having obtained boons, young ascetics are (generally) filled with pride and perish in no time. Do not become one of them.

sa: न च ते तरसा कार्यः कुसुमावचयः स्वयम्। दैवतानि हि मान्यानि पुरुषेण विशेषतः॥
en: Do not pluck there any flowers by the force of your personal might, for the celestials deserve respect and regard from mortals,

sa: राजोवाच इक्ष्वाकवः पश्यत मां गृहीतं न वै शक्नोम्येष शरं विमोक्तुम्। न चास्य कर्तुं नाशमभ्युत्सहामि आयुष्मान् वै जीवतु वामदेवः॥
en: The king said: O Ikshvakus, behold, I am incapable of shooting the arrow that has been taken by me; I fail to kill this Brahmana. Let Vamadeva be blessed with a long life.

sa: लोमश उवाच एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु बृहद्युम्नो महीपतिः। सत्रं तेने महाभागो रैभ्ययाज्य: प्रतापवान्॥
en: Lomasha said: About this time, the highly blessed ruler of earth, the greatly powerful Brihadyumna, the Yajamana of Raivya performed a sacrifice.

sa: दशाश्वस्य सुतस्त्वासीद् राजा परमधार्मिकः। सत्ये तपसि दाने च यस्य नित्यं रतं मनः॥
en: Dashashva's son, o king, was a pious prince whose mind was continually devoted to the practice of truth and charity and devotion.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा शकुनेर्लुब्धकोऽब्रवीत्। वाधते खलु मे शीतं संत्राणं हि विधीयताम्॥
en: Hearing these words of the bird, the fowler replied to him, saying,-I am benumbed with cold. Just make arrangements for warming me.

sa: कृत्स्नं नूनं स दहति इति लोको व्यवस्यति। यत्र त्वं तादृशो भूत्वा धर्ममेवानुपश्यसि॥
en: People say that that king who begins with sternness consumes the entire world. You were stern before. But you now seck righteousness.

sa: श्रवणं स्पर्शनं जिह्वा दृष्टि सा तथैव च। इन्द्रियाणीति पञ्चैते चित्तपूर्वं गता गुणाः॥
en: Hearing, touch, taste, vision, and scent,-these are the five senses. They have derived their attributes from the mind which is their cause.

sa: चतुर्णां यत्र वर्णानां धर्मव्यतिकरो भवेत्। न तत्र वासं कुर्वीत श्रेयोऽर्थी वै कथंचन॥
en: One desirous of acquiring what is excellent should never live in a place where people make a confusion of their respective duties.

sa: सर्वस्य दयिताः प्राणाः सर्वः स्नेहं च विन्दति। तिर्यग्योनिष्वपि सतां स्नेहं पश्यत यादृशम्॥
en: Life is dear to all, and all feel the influence of love. See the affection that is cherished by beasts and birds.

sa: तपो हि तप्यतस्तस्य यत् स्थान परमात्मनः। न तत् सम्प्राप्नुते कश्चिदृते ह्यावां द्विजोत्तम॥
en: No one can go to that realm where the Supreme Soul resides practising penances, except we two, O foremost of twice-born ones.

sa: यो न पश्यति चक्षुर्त्यां नेङ्गते च कथञ्चन॥ तस्य निष्ठावसानान्ते रुदन्तः किं करिष्यथ।
en: What will you profit by crying, for him after death, who does not see with his eyes and stir in the least.

sa: यदि यज्ञांश्च वृक्षांश्च यूपांश्चोद्दिश्य मानवाः। वृथा मांसं न खादन्ति नैष धर्मः प्रशस्यते॥
en: Mentioning respectfully sacrifices and trees and sacrificial stakes, men do not eat tainted meat. This practice, however, is now worthy of praise.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा तेन तुलाधारेण धीमता। प्रोवाच वचनं धीमाजाजलिर्जपतां वरः॥
en: Thus accosted by the intelligent Tuladhara on that occasion, the highly intelligent Jajali, that foremost of ascetics, said these words to him:

sa: पुलाका इव धान्येषु पुत्तिका इव पक्षिषु। तद्विधास्ते मनुष्याणां येषां धर्मो न कारणम्॥
en: They who have no respect for virtue are as vile among men as seedless grains among corn or the gnat among birds.

sa: नैवाकाशे न पशुषु वियोनौ च न पर्वसु। इन्द्रियस्य विसर्ग ते रोचयन्ति कदाचन॥
en: They never allowed the emission of the seminal fluid into empty space, into inferior animals, into forbidden wombs, or on sacred days.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कालमृत्युयमानां ते इक्ष्वाकोर्ब्राह्मणस्य च। विवादो व्याहतः पूर्वं तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Yudhishthira said You had mentioned the dispute between Time, Mrityu, Yama, Ikshvaku, and a Brahmana. You should describe the story in full.

sa: क्रीडते च तथा शर्वः प्रसीदति यथा च वै॥ हृदिस्थः सर्वभूतानां विश्वरूपो महेश्वरः।
en: Who can describe how Sharva sports and how he becomes pleased? Maheshvara of universal form lives in the hearts of all Creatures.

sa: अविद्या कर्म तृष्णा च केचिदाहुः पुनर्भवे। कारणं लोभमोहौ तु दोषाणां तु निषेवणम्॥
en: Some hold that there is re-birth which is caused by Ignorance, the desire for acts, cupidity, carelessness, and bent towards other vices.

sa: न स्नेहस्य च विच्छेदो विलापरुदितस्य च। मृतस्यास्य परित्यागात् तापो वै भविता ध्रुवम्॥
en: If you abandon him, your love will not terminate, nor these piteous cries. On the other hand, your grief will multiply itself.

sa: अथान्तरिक्षे वागासीत् तां च शुश्राव जाजलिः। धर्मेण न समस्त्वं वै तुलाधारस्य जाजले॥
en: Then an unseen voice arose in the sky and Jajali heard these words:-You are not equal, O Jajali, to Tuladhara in righteousness.

sa: एत एवंविधा देवा मनोरेव प्रजापतेः। ते च पूर्वं सुराश्चेति द्विविधाः पितरः स्मृताः॥
en: These were considered as gods at the time of the Prajapati Manu. These were at first called the gods and the Pitris.

sa: यच्चेदं प्रभवः स्थानं भूतानां संयमो. यमः। ' स्वभावेनैव वर्तन्ते द्वन्द्वसृष्टानि भूरिश:॥ सर्गः कालो धृतिर्वेदाः कर्ता कार्य क्रियाफलम्। एतत् ते कथितं तात यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: Time is the origin of all creatures; it is Time which makes them grow; Time is their destroyer; and lastly it is Time which is their ruler. Subject to pairs of opposites, innumerable sorts of creatures rest on Time, according to their own natures.

sa: अप्रमत्तो तथा धन्वी लक्ष्यं हन्ति समाहितः। युक्तः सम्यक् तथा योगी मोक्षं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्॥
en: As a bowman who is careful and attentive succeeds in striking the aim, so the Yogin with absorbed soul, forsooth, acquires Liberation.

sa: यो मे यथा कल्पितवान् भागमस्मिन् महाक्रतौ॥ स तथा यज्ञभागार्हो वेदसूत्रे मया कृतः।
en: In the Veda-sutras I make him the receiver of a share like that which he has himself offered one in this sacrifice.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सांख्यं योगः पाञ्चरात्रं वेदारण्यकमेव च। ज्ञानान्येतानि ब्रह्मर्षे लोकेषु प्रचरन्ति ह॥
en: The Sankhya System, the Pancharatra Scriptures, and the Aranyaka-Vedas—these different systems of knowledge or religion,-0 twice-born Rishi, are current in the world.

sa: अर्यमा चैव भगवान् ये चास्य तनया विभो। एते प्रदेशाः कथिता भुवनानां प्रभावनाः॥
en: The divine Aryaman and his sons, O king, have been described as those who issued injunctions, and as creators of all creatures.

sa: नेयं घ्राणं शरीरं च एते भूमिगुणास्त्रयः। महाभूतानि पञ्चैव षष्ठं च मन उच्यते॥
en: Smell, the nose, and the body are the three properties, of Earth. The great elements are five. The mind is the sixth.

sa: न हि सा तेन सम्भेदं पत्नी नीता महात्मना। विजने चाश्रमस्थेन पुत्रश्चापि समाहितः॥
en: From the time the great Rishi, living in that solitary hermitage did not live separately from his wife or his careful son.

sa: उमोवाच यज्ञमेतं महादेव किमर्थं नाधिगच्छसि। केन वा प्रतिषेधेन गमनं ते न विद्यते॥
en: Uma said Why, O Mahadeva do you not go to that Sacrifice? What objection is there of your going to that place?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा माद्रीपुत्रस्य धीमतः। स तु कौशल संयुक्तं सूक्ष्मचित्रार्थसम्मतम्॥ ततस्तस्योत्तरं वाक्यं स्वरवर्णोपपादितम्। शिक्षया चोपपन्नाय द्रोणशिष्याय भारत॥ उवाच स तु धर्मज्ञो धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः। शरतल्पगतो भीष्मो नकुलाय महात्मने॥
en: Hearing these words of the intelligent son of Madri, the virtuous Bhishma, that perfect master of the science of the bow, lying upon his bed of arrows, answered in many refined words of great significance, of sweet cadence, and showing considerable skill, to the great Nakula, that discipline of Drona of skilful training.

sa: शमश्च दृष्टः परमं बलं च ज्ञानं च सूक्ष्मं च यथावदुक्तम्। तपांसि सूक्ष्माणि सुखानि चैव सांख्ये यथावद् विहितानि राजन्॥
en: Tranquillity of soul, high power, all subtile knowledge of which the scriptures speak, penances of subtile force, and all sorts of happiness, O king, have all been duly ordained in the Sankhya system,

sa: यदा च मम रामेण युद्धमासीत् सुदारुणम्। वसुभिश्च तदा राजन् कथेयं कथिता मम॥
en: On the occasion, again, of my dreadful fight with Rama of Bhrigu's race the celestial Vasus, O king, had recited this history.

sa: उत्थानेन जयेत् तन्द्री वितर्कं निश्चयाज्जयेत्। मौनेन बहुभाष्यं च शौर्येण च भयं त्यजेत्॥
en: By exertion should subdue procrastination, by certainty all kinds of doubt, one by taciturnity, loquaciousness, and by courage every sort of fear.

sa: उपैति सत्याद् दानं हि तथा यज्ञाः सदक्षिणाः। त्रेताग्निहोत्रं वेदाश्च ये चान्ये धर्मनिश्चयाः॥
en: From Truth originate gifts, and sacrifice with presents as well the threefold Agnihotras the Vedas and everything else which leads to righteousness.

sa: भृत्यातिथिषु यो शुढे भुक्तवत्सु सदा सदा। अमृतं केवलं भुते इति विद्धि युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Know, O Yudhisthira, that the man who eats only after having fed his servants and guests becomes an eater always of ambrosia.

sa: अब्रुवं च तदा देवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा। जानुभ्यामवनीं गत्वा प्रणम्य च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Kneeling down to him and bowing to him repeatedly, I then with a voice that was Suppressed with joy, said to him.

sa: अहमासं यथाद्य त्वं भविता त्वं यथा वयम्। मावमंस्था मया कर्म दुष्कृतं कृतमित्युत।॥
en: What I am now you will be in time. Do not disregard me, thinking that you have performed a highly difficult feat.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत्रैव न्यवसन् राजन् निहत्य बकराक्षसम्। अधीयानाः परं ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने॥
en: O king, after killing the Rakshasas Baka, they lived in the house of that Brahmana engaged in the study of the Vedas.

sa: राज्ञा पुत्रफलं देयमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः। अपीदानी स धर्मात्मा इयान्मे दर्शनं रहः॥
en: The king should give me a son. This is a firm resolve. Will not that virtuous-minded king grant me a private interview?

sa: सर्वमेतत् परोक्षं मे यत् त्वं वदसि तापसि। नाहं त्वामभिजानामि यथेष्टं गम्यतां त्वया॥
en: O ascetic woman, all that you say is quite unknown to me. I do not know you. Go away wherever you please.

sa: संजय उवाच इति ब्रुवति राधेयं मद्राणामीश्वरे नृप। अभ्यवर्तत वै कर्णं क्रोधदीप्तो वृकोदरः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, while the son of Radha thus said to the king of Madra, Vrikodara, burning with anger, approached Karna.

sa: तस्य सर्वान् हयान् हत्वा संछिद्य शतधा रथम्॥ अभ्यवर्षच्छरैः कर्णः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्।
en: Next cutting his car into fragments and slaying all his horses, Karna covered him with arrows, like a cloud charged with rain.

sa: तस्य कर्णो हयान हत्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन द्रुतं निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: (Then) Karna, having destroyed his horses with straight shafts, quickly sent his charioteer, with a broad-headed dart, to the abode of Yama.

sa: शृगालवचनात् तेऽपि गताः सर्वे नदी ततः। स चिन्तापरमो भूत्वा तस्थौ तत्रैव जम्बुकः॥
en: Hearing what the Jackal said, they all went to a river. The Jackal waited there, deeply meditating what he should do (next).

sa: कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानेन राज्ञा संचोदितो वनम्। परित्राता जनस्यास्य जगतः क्व नु गच्छति ॥
en: Afflicted by Kaikeyſ and commissioned by the monarch to the woods, where goes the deliverer of these people, of the entire world

sa: आरुरोह रथं चान्यं नन्दकस्य महात्मनः। ततो भीमो हतं मत्वा तव पुत्रं महारथम्॥
en: Mounted on another car belonging to the high-souled Naduka. Then Bhima, thinking Suyodhana to be dead amid (the darkness of) that night.

sa: यदुक्तं वचनं मेऽद्य त्वया मद्रजनेश्वर। भीमसेनं प्रति विभो तत् सत्यं नात्र संशयः॥
en: O king of Madra, what you have said to me today regarding Bhimasena is all true; there is no doubt about it.

sa: तु वै त्वं हि तात ददास्येव ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयाचितम्। वित्तं यच्चान्यदप्याहुन प्रत्याख्यासि कस्यचित्॥
en: O son, you bestow on the Brahmanas wealth or any other thing asked by them and never refuses anything to any one.

sa: एष वे तत्र वैदेह्या विहगः प्रतिहारकः। पक्षी मां तु विशालाक्ष्याः समीपमुपनेष्यति ॥
en: This bird flying up in the sky brought about Sītā's ravishment and this bird shall take me to her having expansive eyes.

sa: स तौ महात्मा गजमन्दगामी शाखामृगस्तत्र चरंश्चरन्तौ। दृष्ट्वा विषादं परमं जगाम चिन्तापरीतो भयभारभग्नः॥
en: Observing them range there, that high-souled monkey, wending slowly like to an elephant and stricken with fear and grief, became exceedingly sorry.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ राजन् किं शेषे कस्माच्छोचसि शत्रुइन्। शत्रुन् प्रताप्य वीर्येण स कथं मृत्युमिच्छसि॥
en: He further said, "O king, rise up. Why do you lie down? O slayer of foes, why do you wish to die?

sa: तथा त्वमपि सर्वासां सरितां वै पतिर्भव। वासश्च ते सदा देव सागरे मकरालये॥
en: You always live, ogod, in the Ocean, that home of Makaras. This Ocean the lord of rivers, will then be under you.

sa: तद् यथा सुरभिः प्राह समवेतास्तु ते तथा। सुतेषु राजन् सर्वेषु हीनेष्वभ्यधिका कृपा॥
en: O king, as Surabhi said, your affection flows equally towards all your sons. Let it be greater towards those that are weak.

sa: भङ्क्त्वा वनं महातेजा हत्वा रक्षांसि संयुगे। दग्ध्वा लङ्कापुरीं भीमां रराज स महाकपिः॥
en: And having devastated the forest, slain the Rākşasas in conflict and burnt the grand city of Lankā, the great monkey appeared there.

sa: ते तु तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रा इव महारथाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे त्यक्त्वा प्राणकृतं भयम्॥
en: Those great warriors, powerful like tigers, reckless of their life, rushed in battle to face that mighty man, careering like a tiger.

sa: एवं कृत्वा त्विदं कार्यं यथेष्टं गच्छ राक्षस। राज्यस्यार्धं प्रदास्यामि मारीच तव सुव्रत॥
en: O Rākşasa, do you go wherever you like after doing this. I shall confer on you, O Mārīca, half of my kingdom.

sa: सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम्। वनानिवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यते शत्रुसूदनम्॥
en: Blessed is Kausalyā, O Rāma, who shall be greatly delighted, on beholding you, the slayer of enemies, gone home from the forest.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा तु कन्या महाराज ब्राह्मणं संशितव्रतम्। तोषयामास शुद्धेन मनसा संशितव्रता॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O great monarch, that damsel observant of vows, began with a pure heart, to propitiate that vow observing Brahmana.

sa: पदानि गणयन् गच्छ स्वानि नैषध कानिचित्। तत्र तेऽहं महाबाहो श्रेयोधास्यामि यत् परम्॥
en: “O king of the Nishadhas! do you proceed counting your own steps. O mighty-armed warrior! I will render great good to you."

sa: न मेऽर्जुनाद् भयं तादृक् कृष्णान्नापि च सात्वतात्। हुतभुग्जन्मनो नैव यादृग्मीमाद् भयं मम॥
en: I do not fear Arjuna or Krishna or Satyaki him born of the sacrificial fire (Dhrishtadyumna) so much as I do Bhimasena.

sa: तत् ते वृकोदरमयं भयं व्येतु महाहवे। व्यपनेष्याम्यहं ह्येनं मा राजन् विमना भव॥
en: There let your fear proceeding from Vrikodara be dispelled; for I shall kill this one. Do not, O king, yield to grief.

sa: राजोवाच अयं ब्रह्मन्नितो राजा वीतहव्यो विसर्ग्यताम्। तस्य पुत्रैर्हि मे कृत्स्नो ब्रह्मन् वंशःप्रणाशितः॥
en: The king said King Vitahavya has come here, O Brahmana! Do you surrender him. His sons, O Brahmana, had destroyed my family.

sa: सर्ववेदाधिगमनं सर्वतीर्थावगाहनम्। सत्यं च वचनं राजन् समं वा स्यान्न वा समम्।। १०४।
en: O king, I tell you, truth is equal to the study of the entire Vedas and ablutions in all the sacred pilgrimages.

sa: तामाबभाषे कल्याणी सा चास्य न शृणोति वै। ततः सुकन्या वल्मीके दृष्ट्वा भार्गवचक्षुषी॥
en: He addressed that blessed lady, but she did not hear him. Then Sukanya saw the eyes of Bhrigu's son within the ant-hill.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः प्रायाद् रथेनाशु शल्यस्तत्र विशाम्पते। यत्र भीमो महेष्वासो व्यद्रावयत वाहिनीम्॥
en: Sanjay said Then, O king, Shalya quickly went on his car where that great bowman Bhima, was engaged in belabouring your army.

sa: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं चैव शल्यं चोवाच भारत। युध्यध्वमनहंकाराः किं चिरं कुरुथेति च॥
en: Addressing Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Shalya said, O Bharata “Do you go on fighting with self-confidence? Why do you tarry at all?”

sa: अश्वपृष्ठे नागपृष्ठे खड्ने धनुषि कर्षणे। भेदे सान्त्वे च दाने च नये मन्त्रे च संमतः॥ यस्य बाहुं समाश्रित्य लङ्का भवति निर्भया। तनयं धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमं विदुः॥
en: He is competent to ride horses and elephants, to wield the sword or draw the bcw, or in sowing dissensions, or giving away, or in counsel, he reposing in whose arm Lanka has cast off fear. Know him to be Atikāya, son to Dhānyamāli.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच पौरोगवो ब्रुवाणोऽहं बल्लवो नाम भारत। उपस्थास्यामि राजानं विराटमिति मे मतिः।।।।
en: Bhima said O Bharata, I shall present myself before the king Virata, calling myself a cook, named Ballava. This is my intention.

sa: नहि वो गमने सङ्गः कदाचित् कस्यचिद्भवेत्। ब्रुवध्वं यस्य या शक्तिः प्लवने प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: And yet no one of you can promise to undertake this journey? You best of monkeys, unfold your respective powers in bounding.

sa: देवा ऊचुः यदि वै तत्र ते श्रद्धा गम्यतां पुत्र मा चिरम्। प्रिये हि तव वर्तामो देवराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: The Deities said If you wish to be there, go them, O son, forthwith, At the command of the king of the celestials, we are ready to do what you like.

sa: ततो मामाह स मुनिर्गर्भमुत्सृज्य मामकम्। द्वीपेऽस्या एव सरितः कन्यैव त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: The Rishi told me, "After bringing forth this child on the island of this river, you will remain a virgin."

sa: शक्ति विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा सौबलं च भयार्दितम्॥ दुद्रुवुस्तावका: सर्वे भये जाते ससौबलाः।
en: Seeing that dart unsuccessful and Subala's so possessed by fear, all your soldiers fled away. Subala's son also joined them.

sa: किं नो हनूमता कार्य कृपणेन तपस्विना। रामे तिष्ठति दुर्धर्षे सुग्रीवेऽपि सलक्ष्मणे॥
en: Rāma the irrepressible existing, and also Sugrīva with Lakşmaņa, what have we to do with the weak and wretched Hanumăn?

sa: यद् गतं तद् गतमिति ममासीन्मनसि स्थितम्। इदानीमत्र किं कार्य प्रकरिष्यामि संजय॥
en: Hitherto I thought that what is gone for good. But, O Sanjaya, what measures is gone should now be adopted.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिर राजा हतं मत्वा सुयोधनम्। अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन यत्र पार्थो वृकोदरः॥
en: And hearing also the yells of the highsouled Bhima, O monarch, king Yudhishthira, also, considered Suyodhana to have been slain.

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यति बीभत्सुरजितो युधि पाण्डवः। भीमसेनो यमौ चोभौ भृशं कौतूहलान्विताः॥
en: And they became curious to learn also invincible Pandavas, Bibhatsa (Arjuna), Bhimasena and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) would say.

sa: ते श्रमेण च कौरव्यास्तृष्णया च प्रपीडिताः। नाशक्नुवंस्तदा गन्तुं निद्रया च प्रवृद्धया॥
en: Those descendants of Kuru (the Pandavas), afflicted with fatigue and thirst and heavy with sleep, were unable to proceed further.

sa: क्षयोऽस्य दुर्मतेः प्राप्तः सानुगस्य महात्मनः। यः प्रदीप्तां हुताशस्य शिखां वै स्पष्टुमर्हति॥
en: This vicious wight has placed his hands in the burning flame so he shall, along with followers, meet with destruction.

sa: स शाटी परितः कट्यां सम्भ्रान्तः परिवेष्ट्यताम्। आविध्य दण्डं चिक्षेप सर्वप्राणेन वेगतः॥
en: Upon this, swiftly tightening the cloth around his waist, Trijața firmly grasping the rod hurled it with a mighty force.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् कुरूणां प्रपितामहः। पुनरेव महाभागो धृतराष्ट्रमुवाच ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said That highly exalted and holy grand father of the Kurus, having said thus, again thus spoke to Dhritarashtra.

sa: चेकितानः शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष । हत्वा त्वदीयं सुमहत् सैन्यं शङ्खानथाधमन्॥
en: Chekitana and Shikhandhin and the five sons of Draupadi, having killed a large number of your troops, blew their conchs.

sa: ऋतुकाले तु सम्प्राप्ते देवयानी वराङ्गना। लेभे गर्भं प्रथमतः कुमारं च व्यजायत॥
en: The beautiful lady, Devayani conceived when her season came. She gave birth to her eldest child which was a boy.

sa: भित्वा तु तां गदां बाणे राघवो धर्मवत्सलः। स्मयमान इदं वाक्यं संरब्धमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Cutting off the mace with his shafts, Rāghava attached to righteousness with a smile said to Khara these angry words.

sa: श्रुत्वा नियोगं ब्रह्मर्षेः सारजा भार्गवी तदा। तथेति पितरं प्राह भार्गवं भृशदुःखिता॥
en: Hearing the words of the Brāhmaṇa saint and preceptor śukra, Arajās sorrowfully said to her father 'it shall be done.'

sa: इमां वा सरितं चाद्य शोषयिष्यामि लक्ष्मण॥ यदि नाख्याति मे सीतामद्य चन्द्रनिभाननाम्।
en: O Lakşmaņa, I shall dry up this river Godāvari if it tell me not about Sītā having a moon-like countenance.

sa: अनुज्ञाता तु भीष्मेण शाल्वं सौभपतिं ततः। कन्येयं मुदिता तत्र काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Permitted by Bhishma this girl rejoicing went to Shalva the lord of Saubha in due time and said these words:

sa: को हि तत्रैव भुक्त्वान्नं भाजनं भेत्तुमर्हसि। मन्यमानः कुले जातमात्मानं पुरुषः क्वचित्॥
en: Is there a man born of a respectable family who will break the very plate after having dined off it?

sa: वृत्र उवाच प्रत्यक्षमेतद् भवतस्तथान्येषां मनीषिणाम्। मया यज्जयलुब्धेन पुरा तप्तं महत् तपः॥
en: Vritra said You and also other sages know full well the severe penances which I practised from greed of victory.

sa: स सम्यक् पूजयित्वा तं विप्रं विप्रर्षभस्तदा। ददौ प्रतिश्रयं तस्मै सदा सर्वातिथिव्रतः॥
en: That best of Brahmanas, ever hospitable to hosts, after duly worshipping him, in his house, gave him quarters to live.

sa: शैब्या च सह सावित्र्या स्वास्तीर्णेन सुवर्चसा। नरयुक्तेन यानेन प्रययौ सेनया वृता॥
en: And Shaivya together with Savitri surrounded by troops, went in a palanquin, adorned with splendid sheets and carried by men.

sa: अहो तवेयं परिचारिका शुभा प्रत्यग्ररूपा प्रतिभाति मामियम्। अयुक्तरूपं हि करोति कर्म ते प्रशास्तु मां यच्च ममास्ति किंचन॥
en: This fine and maid of yours appears to me as one possessed of the blooming beauty of a goddess. The service which she renders to you is quite unsuitable to her.

sa: अन्यथा क्रियमाणे तु अवध्यः स भविष्यति। यदि त्वेवं कृतं वीर विनाशमुपयास्यति॥
en: And by no other means he is to be slain. If you can encompass this, he shall forsooth be slain.

sa: संजय उवाच सैन्धवं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रणे पार्थेन भारत। अमर्षवशमापन्न: कृपः शारद्वतस्ततः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, seeing the king Sindhu slain in battle by Partha, Kripa, the son of Saradvat, waxing wrath.

sa: ग्रस्यमानं सात्यकिना खे सोममिव राहुणा। तं तु शब्दमथ श्रुत्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Devoured by Satyaki, like Soma in the skies devoured by Rahu. Then hearing that woeful exclamation, the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman.

sa: ततो धर्मे विनिष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। सदेवर्षिगणं सर्व विनश्येत्तु न संशयः॥
en: And on the wane of virtue, forsooth, the three worlds, with celestials, saints, mobile and immobile creations, shall be destroyed.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा साध्वी कीचकेनाशुभं वचः। कीचकं प्रत्युवाचेदं गर्हयन्त्यस्य तद् वचः॥
en: Thus addressed by Kichaka in these foul words the chaste Draupadi set his word at naught and addressed him thus.

sa: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च पुत्रशोकपराजिते। प्रसुप्ते न प्रबुध्येते यथा कालसमन्विते ॥
en: Overcome by grief for their sons, Sumitrā and Kausalyā were sleeping as if they were dead, and had not awaked.

sa: शरीराद् विविधाश्चान्ये धातवोऽस्याभवन् नृप। एवं त्यक्त्वा शरीरं च परमे तपसि स्थितः॥
en: O King, various other metals were produced from his body. Thus leaving his material body, he lay absorbed in meditation.

sa: श्रुत्वैव पार्थमायान्तं भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् महाराज सेनां तव ममर्द ह॥
en: Hearing that Partha is come, the redoubtable Bhimasena, O king, began to afflict your troops, fearless of his own life.

sa: अपां पतिं प्रचक्रुर्हि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। अभिषिच्य ततो देवा वरुणं यादसां पतिम्॥
en: Having installed Varuna as the Lord of all aquatic animals and worshipping him duly, the celestials, returned their respective habitations.

sa: भतॄणां वचने चैव न स्थास्यन्ति ततः स्त्रियः। पुत्राश्च मातापितरौ हनिष्यन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: They will never obey the orders of their husbands. When this age will come, sons will kill fathers and mothers,

sa: तानि पर्वतशृङ्गाणि शूलेन स बिभेद ह। बभञ्ज वृक्षवर्षं च कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥
en: And all those mountain-tops he cut off with his dart; and the mighty Kumbhakarņa also baffled the shower of trees.

sa: तेषां चानुगता ये च क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ। तांश्च सर्वानवामृद्गाद् रामः प्रहरता वरः॥
en: O best of Kshatriyas, that foremost of all wielders of arms, Rama, destroyed all those Kshatriyas who were their followers.

sa: भव नस्त्वं महाराज राजेह शरदां शतम्। प्रजाः पालय धर्मेण यथेन्द्रस्त्रिदिवं तथा॥
en: Be, O foremost of king, our monarch for a century and protect your subjects virtuously like Indra protecting the celestials'.

sa: तस्मिन् विप्रदुते क्रूर शाल्वस्याथ चमूपतौ। वेगवान् नाम दैतेयः सुतं मेऽभ्यद्रवद् बली॥
en: When the crooked-minded commander of Shalva's army fled from the field, a powerful Daitya, named Vegavan, rushed at my son.

sa: राक्षसः प्रचकम्पेऽथ लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितः। रुद्रबाणहतं घोरं यथा त्रिपुरगोपुरम्।। चिन्तयामास चाश्वस्य विमृश्य च महाबलः।७४।। साधु बाणनिपातेन श्लाघनीयोऽसि मे रिपुः।
en: The Raksasas, smarting under Laksmana's shaft, showered, like the dreadful gateway of Tripura battered by Rudra. Then recovering himself and reflecting, he said.* *Cintayāmasa-thought, I apprehend, means said in this connection.

sa: न वेदानधिगच्छन्ति व्रतवन्तो द्विजातयः। न यज्ञांस्तन्वते विप्रा यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sinfulness is not restrained, the twice-born ones do not study the Vedas, or practise high vows, or perform sacrifices.

sa: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे समुत्तस्थुः सहस्रशः। स च राजा वयोवृद्धः सृञ्जयो होत्रवाहनः॥
en: Then did all those Rishis by thousands as also Hotravahana, the king of the Srinjayas, old in years, stand up.

sa: ऐश्वर्यं वै महद् ब्रह्म वर्णे कस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्। निवर्तते चापि पुनः कथमैश्वर्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Upon which order (of men) has been placed high Brahma prosperity? In what manner, again, does high prosperity fall off?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स गत्वा हास्तिनपुरं नकुलः समितिंजयः। भीष्ममामन्त्रयाञ्चक्रे धृतराष्ट्रं च पाण्डवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having gone to Hastinapur the ever victorious son of Pandu Nakula at their head, invited Bhishma and Dhritarashtra.

sa: पृथिवीं पर्यटन्तं हि तुरगं कामचारिणम्। कः पालयेदिति मुने तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: You should, O ascetic, say who will protect this horse while roaming over the Earth freely according to its will.

sa: तस्य गन्धस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तरेण बहून् गुणान्॥ इष्टश्चानिष्टगन्धश्च मधुरोऽम्लः कटुस्तथा। निर्हारी संहतः स्निग्धो रूक्षो विशद एव च॥ एवं दशविधो ज्ञेयः पार्थिवो गन्ध इत्युत।
en: I shall describe at length the numerous qualities of smell. Smell is agreeable or disagreeable, sweet, sour, pungent, diffusive and compact, oily and dry, and clear. Thus smell, which belongs to the earth, should be known as of ten sorts.

sa: महेश्वरमुखोत्सृष्टा ये च धर्मगुणाः स्मृताः। ते त्वया मनसा धार्याः कुरुराज दिवानिशम्॥
en: O king of the Kurus, you should also remember those incidents of duty and virtue which were declared by Maheshvara.

sa: त्वया ह्युक्तो विशेषेण गुणवान् स भविष्यति। लोके चैव त्वया देवि प्रमाणत्वमुपैष्यति॥
en: The subject, when described by you will become highly meritorious. Indeed, that subject will then become authoritative in the world.
